In patients who have received previous courses of chem- otherapy the dose should be reduced to 150 mg/m2 for the first cycle of therapy, but may be increased to 200 mg/m2 for subsequent courses if there is no hae- matological toxicity. A dose of 200 mg/m2 daily for 5 days every 28 days is also used for metastatic malignant melanoma. Malignant neoplasms. Temozolomide has been studied1-9 particularly in the management of malignant neoplasms of the brain (p.660). In the UK, guidance has been issued10 on its use in patients with recurrent progressive malignant glioma who have failed first-line chemotherapy treatment with other agents (either because of lack of efficacy or because of adverse effects). 1.
